title: Record the q-adic row excess
body:
## Summary
- For an integer `q > 2^80`, `|GL_64(q)|` has bit length at least `64^2 * 80 = 327680`. The product of `(1 - q^{-i})` exceeds one half already at `q = 3`.
- The published depth is 2, so one level charges at least 655360. The frozen assembler caps the external row at 20161.
- No new kappa. The fourteen stage headrooms stay unrecomputed.
